release_status_reason: The FEX backend adapter is implemented and guest x86-64 executes correctly on a 4 KiB Swan device: the on-device suite passes every assertion it makes, including the same-VA republication regression that exposed the shared code-cache invalidation bug. What remains is unimplemented capability rather than a blocker -- interrupts, bounded Step, real HLE gates and callbacks, multi-thread execution, a context-level publication transaction, and the JNI/app path. Scope is Swan / Android 16 / ARM64 / 4 KiB by the 2026-09-08 decision; 16 KiB cases are deferred and are not counted as passes. See docs/validation/v0/followup-2026-09-08.md.
